provenance_warning: This document reconstructs the declared design and operational settings from the executed notebook and archive. It is not a pre-execution immutable specification and does not cure the campaign's missing-specification blocker.
research_question: Does organization remain a distinct, reference-independent operational construct when distinction density is resolved relative to explicit symmetry/reference conditions, and does projection preserve organization monotonically across bounded organizational DoF?
null_hypothesis: Organization candidates are redundant with ordinary graph controls or collapse into the selected reference-resolved distinction density; projection is monotone within the bounded domain.
experimental_hypothesis: At least one organization candidate retains nonredundant signal after graph controls, distinction density varies with the declared reference condition, and projection monotonicity is only partial or counterexample-bearing within the bounded domain.

independent_variables.name: organization_candidate
independent_variables.definition: Candidate organization score computed from matched-null standardized structural deviations before reference-specific distinction-density resolution.

independent_variables.name: reference_condition
independent_variables.definition: Declared feature-family weighting used to resolve reference-dependent distinction density.

independent_variables.name: organizational_dof
independent_variables.definition: Bounded DoF inherited from the Notebook 16 meaningful-result catalog.

controls: Use matched-null z-score features from the supplied Notebook 16 meaningful archive.
Include ordinary graph invariants as control predictors.
Use five-fold cross-validation for predictive independence tests.
Use 1,000 bootstrap repeats where the notebook declares bootstrap analysis.
Keep the symbolic organization encoding and source catalog fixed.
Do not interpret organization as a primitive or external physical quantity.
termination_conditions: Stop after all supplied organization, projection, and perturbation rows are processed.
Fail if required Notebook 16 input files are absent or the input manifest is not EXECUTED.
Mark an axiom test NOT_TESTABLE when required class coverage or source vectors are absent.
Export counterexamples and non-identifiability conditions rather than suppressing them.
interpretation_protocol: Report organization candidates as operational constructions only.
Treat reference variation as evidence of reference-dependent resolution, not as proof of a universal reference law.
Treat positive incremental predictive deltas as bounded nonredundant signal, not causality.
Treat projection monotonicity violations as counterexamples to strong monotonicity within the tested domain.
Preserve NOT_TESTABLE, counterexample, and missing-data outcomes.
Cap the result at C2 bounded notebook output with limitations.
